params.name: input
params.label: Input
params.description: Node whose geometry is used as the seed shape when Source is set to Input.

params.name: source
params.label: Source
params.description: Starting shape: Internal builds a UV sphere from Radius and Base Resolution; Input uses the geometry wired into Input.

params.name: method
params.label: Method
params.description: Basic passes the source shape on as it is; Scatter scatters points over its surface and wraps them in a convex hull, giving an evenly spaced mesh.

params.name: base_resolution
params.label: Base Resolution
params.description: Rows and columns of the internal UV sphere. Higher values give a smoother, denser seed.

params.name: radius
params.label: Radius
params.description: Radius of the internal sphere in world units, centered at the origin.

params.name: scatter_count
params.label: Scatter Count
params.description: Number of points scattered over the source surface before the hull is built. More points give a finer hull mesh.

params.name: scatter_seed
params.label: Scatter Seed
params.description: Random seed for the scatter. Change it for a different but equally spaced point layout.

params.name: relax_points
params.label: Relax Points
params.description: When on, pushes the scattered points apart across the surface so they are evenly spaced before the hull is built.

params.name: scatter_relax_iterations
params.label: Scatter Relax Iterations
params.description: How many push-apart passes the scattered points get. More passes give a more even spacing; 0 does none.

params.name: scale_radii_by
params.label: Scale Radii By
params.description: Multiplier on each scattered point's push radius, which is derived from the surface area per point. Larger values spread points more forcefully.

params.name: use_max_relax_radius
params.label: Use Max Relax Radius
params.description: When on, the scattered points' push radius is capped at Scatter Relax Radius.

params.name: scatter_relax_radius
params.label: Scatter Relax Radius
params.show_when: method == Scatter && relax_points == true && use_max_relax_radius == true
params.description: Upper limit on the scattered points' push radius in world units, used when Use Max Relax Radius is on.

params.name: relax_iterations
params.label: Relax Iterations
params.description: Passes of the final repel relax that pushes the mesh's points apart. 0 turns the relax off.

params.name: relax_radius
params.label: Relax Radius
params.description: Radius in world units of the sphere each point pushes with in the final relax; points closer than twice this move apart.

params.name: relax_in_3d_space
params.label: Relax in 3D Space
params.description: When off, the final relax slides points along the surface to keep its shape; when on, points may move freely in 3D.

params.name: subdivision_depth
params.label: Subdivision Depth
params.description: How many times each triangle is split into four at the end, without smoothing. 0 leaves the mesh as is.
